viability_verdict.reasoning: Hashtag volumes are massive — #doordash 13.3B, #uberdriver 7.85B, #doordashdriver 1.52B all clear the 100M threshold by 10-130x. Six of seven tested tags are viable. HOWEVER, top videos do NOT discuss tax/mileage tools directly — they discuss earnings, gas costs, deactivation, day-in-the-life. Mileage-tracker content would be a NEW vertical inside an active community, not riding existing creator output. CONDITIONAL on creator-strategy: Mileway has to MAKE the tax/mileage angle relatable (e.g. 'I made $270 today — here's what the IRS sees', 'gas + miles deduction math in 30 seconds'), not search for existing creators in that lane.
viability_verdict.implication_for_d3: Audience is there at 22B+ cumulative views. Channel: organic short-form videos with earnings + tax math overlays. Cost: $0 (record on phone). Distribution risk: low (tags are not saturated with mileage-app content).
